usedFor: Formcrafts builds forms, and “New Form Created” starts a template whenever a form is made.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Created” in Formcrafts, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each new form gets a task, so nobody forgets to review it.

watchOut: “New Form Created” in Formcrafts is polling, so a template runs after a scheduled check, not at once.
